mapper.select: SELECT /* commonCodeDetailMapper.getMaxSortOrder, groupCode 별, sortOrder Number 최대값 조회 */ IFNULL(MAX(SORT_ORDER),0) FROM COMMON_CODE_DETAIL WHERE GROUP_CODE = #{groupCode}

SELECT /* boardMapper.getCategoryListByBoardCode 특정 게시판(boardCode)에 소속된 카테고리 목록 조회 */ CCD.CODE_ID AS categoryId , CCD.CODE_NAME AS categoryName FROM BOARD_MASTER BM INNER JOIN COMMON_CODE_DETAIL CCD ON BM.GROUP_CODE = CCD.GROUP_CODE WHERE BM.BOARD_CODE = #{boardCode} AND BM.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CCD.SORT_ORDER ASC
SELECT /* CommonCodeDetailMapper.readCommonDetailCode (그룹 코드 상세 전체 리스트 조회) */ GROUP_CODE , CODE_ID , CODE_NAME , SORT_ORDER , USE_YN FROM COMMON_CODE_DETAIL ORDER BY SORT_ORDER

SELECT /* CommonCodeDetailMapper.readCommonDetailCode (그룹코드 상세 조회) */ GROUP_CODE , CODE_ID , CODE_NAME , SORT_ORDER , USE_YN , CREATE_AT FROM COMMON_CODE_DETAIL WHERE GROUP_CODE = #{groupCode} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER
